windows_checks: On display TL160ADMP11-0, start the game and confirm the title shows revision craft-01-fix1. Check English and Simplified Chinese at UI 1.0/1.25/1.5; preserve normal mouse use on the other display.

Start a new game: the first morning should be clear with a sun icon on the HUD clock. Advance time and sail through several regions (the Stormbelt for storms, the Moonwake for fog, the Emberreach for ash). Rain, fog drift, lightning and ash should read well in motion, never hide crew or UI, and stop below decks. Thunder should follow a flash after a short delay.
Turn 'Weather effects' off and on in the System window, and turn on Reduce motion: rain and fog stay, flashes go.
Move between the title, the ship, an island and a battle: each change should sweep smoothly with no flicker, colour shift or stall; with Reduce motion it should be a short crossfade.

Fight land battles including a boss (Old Lookout) and a rival captain: the opening glide, the boss intro with horn and name card (also try clicking it away), the boss bar draining, and the slow-motion finishing blow. Check at each battle speed and with Reduce motion.
Listen to the rain and storm beds, the thunder and the boss horn on speakers next to the music and ambience; report anything too loud, too quiet or tiring.

Watch the frame rate in port, at sea in a storm and in a large battle: the weather layer and the stage sweep were only ever drawn by a software renderer. Assess longer-term balance; it was not covered by this pass.
known_issues: At 1280x720 / VSync / 240 Hz, sampled steady scenes average 239-241 FPS. Synchronous stage construction costs 17-75 ms; first land-battle transition includes a 128 ms frame (boss entry 102 ms). These wall-frame timings are not GPU execution timers.

Exiting the final exported title with active music/ambience under the Dummy audio backend returns code 0 but reports 8 audio playback/sequence instances and 4 audio resources at exit, with no running-script errors. Observed using --quit-after 180; UI Quit also calls SceneTree.quit directly, so this is not established as CLI-only. Normal sound-device shutdown remains untested. Fresh-profile GPU startup, source GPU probe, final localization probes and headless suites exit cleanly. See build/validation/craft-takeover/fixed-release-title/render.log.
